reviewTitle: Great for sleep, very comfortable. Don't use for the Range.
reviewDescription: I'm 40F, 5'3" 130#, small. These are great for sleeping. At first I thought these might be too big, still, but I've gotten used to them. They are much more comfortable than standard plugs. I sleep much more soundly with these earplugs. I have to be up at 0415 each day, and sleep is extremely important. I'm very sensitive to any noise at night. I used to wake up 7-10x a night due to my dogs' noise and now, I wake maybe once or twice at the most and it's just because I'm too hot/cold. I am military, and thought these might be more comfortable at the range, but no. Don't replace your triple-flange for these, they're not good for the impact noise of gun fire. I tried a tripple flange in one ear, and this in the other-- the tripple flange are **much** more effective, even without firing, but much less comfortable for me to keep in my ears long-term (no way I could sleep with tripple fange in my ears). Last night, I tried sleeping in a hotel room by myself without these ear plugs and I woke up 6-8x with no one in the room. I should have worn them! There's a comfortable muffled fullness that these provide that allow me to sleep very well (when I use them!). At home I use them every night. Be sure to wash your hands before going to bed and swap the plugs out occasionally, otherwise you'll breakout in the inner ear, and that hurts. Also, let your ears dry out after a shower before inserting.
